svg.title: Where an attacker could reach
svg.desc: The robotaxi seen from the front left with numbered markers where the assets of the threat analysis (WP-C-09) sit, and a list of the assets with their number of threat scenarios and highest risk: A-01 Remote driving commands, 2 threats, risk 5 of 5; A-02 Remote assistance and release messages, 2 threats, risk 5 of 5; A-03 Remote operator accounts and the operations station, 1 threats, risk 5 of 5; A-04 Trip and route commands from the fleet backend, 1 threats, risk 4 of 5; A-05 Safety monitor firmware and envelope parameters, 1 threats, risk 2 of 5; A-06 Autoware software, parameters and ML models, 2 threats, risk 4 of 5; A-07 HD map data, 2 threats, risk 4 of 5; A-08 Update packages and the update channel, 1 threats, risk 2 of 5; A-09 Sensor inputs (LiDAR, cameras, radar, GNSS, microphones), 3 threats, risk 5 of 5; A-10 Command path to the drive-by-wire (I-03, I-04), 2 threats, risk 2 of 5; A-11 Passenger trip data and cabin video, 1 threats, risk 3 of 5; A-12 Fleet telemetry and vehicle positions, 2 threats, risk 5 of 5; A-13 Passenger interface (stop request, doors), 1 threats, risk 3 of 5.

g.text: ASSETS OF WP-C-09, WITH THEIR THREAT SCENARIOS
Remote operator accounts and the operations …
Trip and route commands from the fleet backend
Safety monitor firmware and envelope parameters
Autoware software, parameters and ML models
Update packages and the update channel
Command path to the drive-by-wire (I-03, I-04)
Passenger trip data and cabin video
Risk 3 or more is reduced by a control (WP-C-09 method); positions on the car are illustrative.
The assets the TARA protects, on and around the robotaxi, coloured by the highest risk of the threats against them.
ILLUSTRATION · positions illustrative · draft for engineering review
